verdict.rationale: The firm's own public Publications page openly lists guides and reports, including founder-relevant analyses of the 2026 Startup Notification (recognition, deep-tech pathway, turnover thresholds) and the tax treatment of ESOP buybacks, so some startup and equity explainers are public. These are legal-update analyses, not a dedicated plain-language startup knowledge base. Missing for 10: a dedicated startup knowledge hub or FAQ section, plain-language guides on company formation and fundraising or financing rounds, broader equity primers beyond a single ESOP tax ruling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
